answer: Think of identity as a passport earned through escrow. A new key must open time-locked payment channels with several randomly drawn established agents and keep real capital locked there for a fixed period; standing is granted only when those channels settle cleanly. In a nebula of anonymous keys, a fake farm gains nothing, because each extra persona needs its own locked collateral and an honest counterparty willing to trade on the mesa. The beacon is solvency, not paperwork: an attacker must idle capital per identity and tie it up for weeks, while honest agents recycle the same funds.
